newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: P&O Nedlloyd buys containers for $99 mln.
newsitem.headline: P&O Nedlloyd buys containers for $99 mln.

text.p: Transport group Nedlloyd NV said on Wednesday its Anglo-Dutch shipping joint venture P&O Nedlloyd would invest $99 million in new containers.

The order totals 40,000 twenty foot equivalent units (TEUs) and will consist of 20 and 40 ft standard containers and 40 and 45 ft hi-cubes. New refrigerated equipment will include 20 and 40 ft hi-cube units.
The containers will be produced by manufacturers in China and South Korea this year and will replace older existing equipment, Nedlloyd said.
